notes: The simulation domain ported stage by stage from the Python harness. Inputs are the real run data reduced to the fields each stage reads: the 2018-2019 label timeline, the 2019-12-31 bridge and 2020-2022 window, the human marks, and the real per-run stage inputs. The full-run reductions come from the reference CLI for SIM-01, SIM-03, and every check config; the window, oracle, and review reductions were captured from the reference functions those commands call. The fixture is flat: the bulky shared input arrays live in PORT-001.datasets.json beside it.

cases.name: sim-02-windows
cases.notes: SIM-02 window selection on the real 2018-2019 label timeline. The input carries the full label timeline and the post-overlap candidate groups; the port re-runs the window fit and the year-stratified sample.

cases.name: sim-02-oracle
cases.notes: SIM-02 oracle on the real selected windows. The input is the real label series plus the window indices; the chart name and run id are the reference config values.
